description: Find the sections of the OnlyMCP documentation that answer a question, for example how tokens work, what a team shares or how an MCP server is connected. Meant for a question in words when the right page is not known; not for reading a whole page. Answers up to five sections, best match first, each with its page, heading, address and the passage that matched, or says that nothing matched. Reads only public documentation: no account, no stored content.

language.description: Language of the answer: en (default), de, fr or it. A page not yet translated comes back in English.

query.description: The question or a few keywords, for example "revoke a token" or "share servers with a team". The first eight words count.

name: search_docs
title: Search the OnlyMCP documentation
